//! The SAME evasion in a second place, so the limit is visibly a property
//! of the needle set and not of one location.

type Clock = std::time::SystemTime;

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn another_case() -> i64 {
    let t = Clock::now();
    t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}
